name: data-table
useFor: Use for records people sort, filter and act on (purchases, cards, agents). Pass columns (header, accessor, cell, sortable), data and getRowId. Add selectable for bulk actions and pageSizes to let people choose rows per page; put actions in toolbar.
constraints: More than one table per page without headings
title: Data Table
description: The brand's ruled table with a search field, sortable heads, row selection, a Columns menu and page keys.
